public_domain_references.bsb: In the morning you must present yourselves tribe by tribe. The tribe that the LORD selects shall come forward clan by clan, and the clan that the LORD selects shall come forward family by family, and the family that the LORD selects shall come forward man by man.
public_domain_references.web: In the morning therefore you shall be brought near by your tribes. It shall be that the tribe which Yahweh selects shall come near by families. The family which Yahweh selects shall come near by households. The household which Yahweh selects shall come near man by man.
public_domain_references.asv: In the morning therefore ye shall be brought near by your tribes: and it shall be, that the tribe which Jehovah taketh shall come near by families; and the family which Jehovah shall take shall come near by households; and the household which Jehovah shall take shall come near man by man.
public_domain_references.kjv: In the morning therefore ye shall be brought according to your tribes: and it shall be, [that] the tribe which the LORD taketh shall come according to the families [thereof;] and the family which the LORD shall take shall come by households; and the household which the LORD shall take shall come man by man.
public_domain_references.brenton: And ye shall all be gathered together by your tribes in the morning, and it shall come to pass that the tribe which the Lord shall shew, ye shall bring by families; and the family which the Lord shall shew, ye shall bring by households; and the household which the Lord shall shew, ye shall bring man by man.

pob.text: And the one who is taken with the devoted thing shall be burned with fire[a], he and all that belongs to him, because he has transgressed the covenant of Yahweh and because he has done an outrageous thing in Israel.

spob.text: The person found with the devoted thing[a] must be burned with fire, together with everything that belongs to him, because he has broken Yahweh’s covenant and committed an outrageous act in Israel.

public_domain_references.bsb: The one who is caught with the things devoted to destruction must be burned, along with all that belongs to him, because he has transgressed the covenant of the LORD and committed an outrage in Israel.’”
public_domain_references.web: It shall be, that he who is taken with the devoted thing shall be burned with fire, he and all that he has, because he has transgressed Yahweh’s covenant, and because he has done a disgraceful thing in Israel.’”
public_domain_references.asv: And it shall be, that he that is taken with the devoted thing shall be burnt with fire, he and all that he hath; because he hath transgressed the covenant of Jehovah, and because he hath wrought folly in Israel.
public_domain_references.kjv: And it shall be, [that] he that is taken with the accursed thing shall be burnt with fire, he and all that he hath: because he hath transgressed the covenant of the LORD, and because he hath wrought folly in Israel.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the man who shall be pointed out, shall be burnt with fire, and all that he has; because he has transgressed the covenant of the Lord, and has wrought wickedness in Israel.

pob.text: Then Joshua said to Achan[a], “My son, please give glory to Yahweh, the God of Israel, and give thanks to him. Please tell me what you have done; do not hide it from me.”

spob.text: Then Joshua said to Achan, “My son, please honor Yahweh, the God of Israel, and thank him.[a] Please tell me what you did. Hide nothing from me.”

public_domain_references.web: Joshua said to Achan, “My son, please give glory to Yahweh, the God of Israel, and make confession to him. Tell me now what you have done! Don’t hide it from me!”

pob.text: I saw among the spoil one beautiful cloak from Shinar[a], two hundred shekels of silver, and one bar of gold weighing fifty shekels. I coveted them and took them, and look, they are hidden in the ground inside my tent[c][b], with the silver underneath it.

spob.text: Among the plunder I saw a beautiful cloak from Shinar, silver weighing two hundred shekels,[a] and a gold bar[b] weighing fifty shekels. I craved them and took them. Look! They are buried in the ground inside my tent, with the silver under the cloak.[c]

pob.text: So Joshua sent messengers[a], and they ran to the tent; and behold, it was hidden in his tent, with the silver underneath it.

pob.text: They took them from inside the tent and brought them to Joshua and to all the sons of Israel[c][b][a], and they laid them out before Yahweh.

pob.text: Then Joshua took Achan son of Zerah[a], and the silver, the cloak, the bar of gold, his sons, his daughters, his ox, his donkey, his flock, his tent[b], and all that belonged to him—and all Israel with him—and they brought them up to the Valley of Achor.

pob.text: And Joshua said[a], “Why have you troubled us? Yahweh will trouble you this day.” And all Israel stoned him with stones[c][b], and they burned them with fire and stoned them with stones.

pob.text: Then Yahweh said to Joshua[a], “Do not fear and do not be dismayed. Take with you all the fighting men, and arise, go up to Ai. See, I have given into your hand the king of Ai, his people, his city, and his land.”

public_domain_references.bsb: Now the allotment for the clans of the tribe of Judah extended to the border of Edom, to the Wilderness of Zin at the extreme southern boundary:
public_domain_references.web: The lot for the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families was to the border of Edom, even to the wilderness of Zin southward, at the uttermost part of the south.
public_domain_references.asv: And the lot for the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families was unto the border of Edom, even to the wilderness of Zin southward, at the uttermost part of the south.
public_domain_references.kjv: [This] then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families; [even] to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward [was] the uttermost part of the south coast.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the borders of the tribe of Juda according to their families were from the borders of Idumea from the wilderness of Sin, as far as Cades southward.

pob.text: Their southern border was from the end of the Salt Sea[b][a], from the tongue that faces southward.

spob.text: Their southern border began at the south-facing bay at the end of the Salt Sea.[a][b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Their southern border started at the bay on the southern tip of the Salt Sea,
public_domain_references.web: Their south border was from the uttermost part of the Salt Sea, from the bay that looks southward;
public_domain_references.asv: And their south border was from the uttermost part of the Salt Sea, from the bay that looketh southward;
public_domain_references.kjv: And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea, from the bay that looketh southward:
public_domain_references.brenton: And their borders were from the south as far as a part of the salt sea from the high country that extends southward.

pob.text: Then it went out southward to the ascent of Akrabbim[a], crossed over to Zin, went up from the south to Kadesh-barnea, crossed over Hezron, went up to Addar[b], and turned toward Karka.

spob.text: From there, the border ran south to the uphill pass at Akrabbim,[a] crossed over to Zin, and then went up south of Kadesh-barnea.[b] It then passed Hezron, went up to Addar, and turned toward Karka.[c]

public_domain_references.bsb: proceeded south of the Ascent of Akrabbim, continued on to Zin, went over to the south of Kadesh-barnea, ran past Hezron up to Addar, and curved toward Karka.
public_domain_references.web: and it went out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and went up by the south of Kadesh Barnea, and passed along by Hezron, went up to Addar, and turned toward Karka;
public_domain_references.asv: and it went out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and went up by the south of Kadesh-barnea, and passed along by Hezron, and went up to Addar, and turned about to Karka;
public_domain_references.kjv: And it went out to the south side to Maaleh-acrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and ascended up on the south side unto Kadesh-barnea, and passed along to Hezron, and went up to Adar, and fetched a compass to Karkaa:
public_domain_references.brenton: And they proceed before the ascent of Acrabin, and go out round Sena, and go up from the south to Cades Barne; and go out to Asoron, and proceed up to Sarada, and go out by the way that is west of Cades.

pob.text: Then it passed on to Azmon[a], and went out to the Brook of Egypt; and the boundary ended at the sea. This shall be your southern boundary.

spob.text: From there, the boundary continued to Azmon. It then reached the Brook of Egypt[a] and ended at the sea. This will be your southern boundary.

public_domain_references.bsb: It proceeded to Azmon, joined the Brook of Egypt, and ended at the Sea. This was their southern border.
public_domain_references.web: and it passed along to Azmon, went out at the brook of Egypt; and the border ended at the sea. This shall be your south border.
public_domain_references.asv: and it passed along to Azmon, and went out at the brook of Egypt; and the goings out of the border were at the sea: this shall be your south border.
public_domain_references.kjv: [From thence] it passed toward Azmon, and went out unto the river of Egypt; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea: this shall be your south coast.
public_domain_references.brenton: And they go out to Selmona, and issue at the valley of Egypt; and the termination of its boundaries shall be at the sea: these are their boundaries southward.

pob.text: And the eastern border was the Salt Sea, as far as the mouth of the Jordan. And the border on the north side was from the tongue of the sea, from the mouth of the Jordan.

pob.text: Then the border went up to Beth-hoglah[a], and passed north of Beth-arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan son of Reuben.

spob.text: The boundary line then went up to Beth-hoglah. It continued past the north side of Beth-arabah, then went up to Bohan’s stone. Bohan was a son of Reuben.

pob.text: And the border went up to Debir from the Valley of Achor[a], and turned northward toward Gilgal, which is opposite the Ascent of Adummim, which is south of the wadi. Then the border passed on to the waters of En-shemesh[c][b], and its end was at En-rogel.

spob.text: From the Valley of Achor, the border went up to Debir. It then turned north toward Gilgal,[a] which is across from the Ascent of Adummim. The ascent lies south of the seasonal streambed. From there, the border continued to the waters of En-shemesh and ended at En-rogel.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then the border went up to Debir from the Valley of Achor, turning north to Gilgal, which faces the Ascent of Adummim south of the ravine. It continued along the waters of En-shemesh and came out at En-rogel.
public_domain_references.web: The border went up to Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that faces the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the river. The border passed along to the waters of En Shemesh, and ended at En Rogel.
public_domain_references.asv: and the border went up to Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that is over against the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the river; and the border passed along to the waters of En-shemesh, and the goings out thereof were at En-rogel;
public_domain_references.kjv: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that [is] before the going up to Adummim, which [is] on the south side of the river: and the border passed toward the waters of En-shemesh, and the goings out thereof were at En-rogel:
public_domain_references.brenton: And the borders continue on to the fourth part of the valley of Achor, and go down to Galgal, which is before the approach of Adammin, which is southward in the valley, and terminate at the water of the fountain of the sun; and their going forth shall be the fountain of Rogel.

pob.text: Then the border went up by the Valley of Ben-hinnom to the slope of the Jebusite on the south (that is[a], Jerusalem), and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies west of the Valley of Hinnom[c][b], at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim.

spob.text: Then the border went up along the Valley of Ben-hinnom to the southern slope of the Jebusite site, which is Jerusalem. It continued up to the top of the mountain west of the Valley of Hinnom, at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim.

public_domain_references.bsb: From there the border went up the Valley of Hinnom along the southern slope of the Jebusites (that is, Jerusalem) and ascended to the top of the hill that faces the Valley of Hinnom on the west, at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim.
public_domain_references.web: The border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom to the side of the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem) southward; and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the farthest part of the valley of Rephaim northward.
public_domain_references.asv: and the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the side of the Jebusite southward (the same is Jerusalem); and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lieth before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the uttermost part of the vale of Rephaim northward;
public_domain_references.kjv: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite; the same [is] Jerusalem: and the border went up to the top of the mountain that [lieth] before the valley of Hinnom westward, which [is] at the end of the valley of the giants northward:
public_domain_references.brenton: And the borders go up to the valley of Ennom, behind Jebus southward; this is Jerusalem: and the borders terminate at the top of the mountain, which is before the valley of Ennom toward the sea, which is by the side of the land of Raphain northward.

pob.text: Then the border curved from the top of the mountain to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah[a], and went out to the cities of Mount Ephron; then the border curved to Baalah (that is, Kiriath-jearim).

spob.text: Then the border curved[a] from the mountaintop to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah. From there it continued to the cities of Mount Ephron, then curved to Baalah, also called Kiriath-jearim.

public_domain_references.bsb: From the hilltop the border curved to the spring of the Waters of Nephtoah, proceeded to the cities of Mount Ephron, and then bent around toward Baalah (that is, Kiriath-jearim).

public_domain_references.asv: and the border extended from the top of the mountain unto the fountain of the waters of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border extended to Baalah (the same is Kiriath-jearim);
public_domain_references.kjv: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border was drawn to Baalah, which [is] Kirjath-jearim:
public_domain_references.brenton: And the border [going forth] from the top of the mountain terminates at the fountain of the water of Naphtho, and terminates at mount Ephron; and the border will lead to Baal; this is the city of Jarim.

pob.text: Then the border turned from Baalah westward to Mount Seir[a], passed along to the northern slope of Mount Jearim (that is, Chesalon), went down to Beth-shemesh, and passed on to Timnah.

public_domain_references.kjv: And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir, and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim, which [is] Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Beth-shemesh, and passed on to Timnah:

pob.text: Then the border went out to the shoulder of Ekron northward[a], and the border bent toward Shikkeron, and passed over Mount Baalah, and went out to Jabneel[c][b]; and the ends of the border were at the sea.

pob.text: And the western border was the Great Sea as a border[a]. This was the border of the sons of Judah all around[b], by their clans.

spob.text: The Great Sea (the Mediterranean Sea) formed the western border. This was the boundary all around the territory of the sons of Judah, according to their clans.

public_domain_references.brenton: These [are] the borders of the children of Juda round about according to their families.

pob.text: And to Caleb son of Jephunneh he gave a portion among the sons of Judah[a], according to the command of Yahweh to Joshua: Kiriath-arba (Arba was the father of Anak), that is[b], Hebron.

pob.text: And Caleb drove out from there the three sons of Anak: Sheshai[a], Ahiman, and Talmai[b], the children of Anak.

pob.text: She said[a], “Please give me a blessing, since you have given me the land of the Negev[c][b]; give me also springs of water.” So he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

pob.text: And the lot came out for the sons of Joseph from the Jordan at Jericho[a], to the waters of Jericho on the east, through the wilderness[b], going up from Jericho into the hill country of Bethel.

spob.text: The territory assigned by lot to Joseph’s descendants began at the Jordan near Jericho. The boundary ran eastward to the waters of Jericho,[a] then through the wilderness and up from Jericho into the hill country of Bethel.

pob.text: Then it went out from Bethel to Luz[a], and passed on to the border of the Arkites at Ataroth.

spob.text: From Bethel, the boundary went to Luz. Then it continued to the border of the Arkites at Ataroth.[a]

public_domain_references.asv: and it went out from Beth-el to Luz, and passed along unto the border of the Archites to Ataroth;
public_domain_references.kjv: And goeth out from Beth-el to Luz, and passeth along unto the borders of Archi to Ataroth,
public_domain_references.brenton: And they will go out to Bæthel, and will proceed to the borders of Achatarothi.

pob.text: Then it went down westward to the border of the Japhletites[a], as far as the border of Lower Beth-horon, and as far as Gezer; and its goings out were at the sea.

spob.text: The boundary then went down westward to the border of the Japhletites. It continued as far as the border of Lower Beth-horon and then to Gezer, ending at the sea.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then it descended westward to the border of the Japhletites as far as the border of Lower Beth-horon and on to Gezer, and it ended at the Sea.

public_domain_references.kjv: And goeth down westward to the coast of Japhleti, unto the coast of Beth-horon the nether, and to Gezer: and the goings out thereof are at the sea.
public_domain_references.brenton: And they will go across to the sea to the borders of Aptalim, as far as the borders of Bæthoron the lower, and the going forth of them shall be to the sea.

pob.text: And the sons of Joseph[a], Manasseh and Ephraim, received their inheritance.

spob.text: And the descendants of Joseph—the tribes of Manasseh and Ephraim—received the land assigned to them.

public_domain_references.brenton: And the sons of Joseph, Ephraim and Manasse, took their inheritance.

pob.text: And the territory of the sons of Ephraim by their clans was as follows: the border of their inheritance on the east was Ataroth-addar[a], as far as Upper Beth-horon.

spob.text: The territory of Ephraim’s sons, clan by clan, was as follows: the eastern border of their inheritance was Ataroth-addar, as far as Upper Beth-horon.

public_domain_references.brenton: And the borders of the children of Ephraim were according to their families, and the borders of their inheritance were eastward to Ataroth, and Eroc as far as Bæthoron the upper, and Gazara.

pob.text: Then the border went out westward to Michmethath on the north[a], and the border turned eastward to Taanath-shiloh, and passed it on the east to Janoah.

pob.text: Then it went down from Janoah to Ataroth and Naarah[a], and reached Jericho[c][b], and ended at the Jordan.

spob.text: From Janoah, the boundary went down to Ataroth and Naarah,[a] then reached Jericho and ended at the Jordan.

spob.text: From Tappuah, the border runs west to the Brook of Kanah and ends at the sea. This is the inherited land of the tribe of the sons of Ephraim, family by family.

pob.text: And the cities set apart for the sons of Ephraim within the inheritance of the sons of Manasseh—all the cities and their villages[a].

spob.text: The descendants of Ephraim also had cities set apart for them within the land inherited by the descendants of Manasseh—all those cities and their villages.

pob.text: But they did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, so the Canaanites have lived in the midst of Ephraim to this day and became forced laborers.

spob.text: But the people of Ephraim did not drive out the Canaanites living in Gezer. So the Canaanites continued to live among the Ephraimites to the narrator’s own day, and they became forced laborers.

public_domain_references.kjv: And they drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer: but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day, and serve under tribute.

pob.text: The lot fell to the tribe of Manasseh[a], for he was the firstborn of Joseph: to Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, there belonged Gilead and Bashan.

spob.text: The tribe of Manasseh received land by lot because Manasseh was Joseph’s firstborn son. Machir was Manasseh’s firstborn son and the father of Gilead.[a] Because Machir was a warrior, Gilead and Bashan were assigned to him.

public_domain_references.bsb: Now this was the allotment for the tribe of Manasseh as Joseph’s firstborn son, namely for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh and father of the Gileadites, who had received Gilead and Bashan because Machir was a man of war.
public_domain_references.web: This was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph. As for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.
public_domain_references.asv: And [this] was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he was the first-born of Joseph. As for Machir the first-born of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.
public_domain_references.kjv: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he [was] the firstborn of Joseph; [to wit], for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead: because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the borders of the tribe of the children of Manasse, (for he [was] the first-born of Joseph,) [assigned] to Machir the first-born of Manasse the father of Galaad, for he was a warrior, [were] in the land of Galaad and of Basan.

pob.text: And it was for the remaining sons of Manasseh according to their clans: for the sons of Abiezer[a], and for the sons of Helek, and for the sons of Asriel, and for the sons of Shechem, and for the sons of Hepher, and for the sons of Shemida. These were the male sons of Manasseh son of Joseph[c][b], according to their clans.

spob.text: The rest of Manasseh’s sons[a] received land according to their clans[b]: the male descendants of Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher, and Shemida. These were the male descendants of Manasseh, son of Joseph.

public_domain_references.bsb: So this allotment was for the rest of the descendants of Manasseh—the clans of Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher, and Shemida. These are the other male descendants of the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph.

These were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.

public_domain_references.kjv: There was also [a lot] for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families; for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these [were] the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families.

pob.text: Zelophehad son of Hepher[a], son of Gilead, son of Machir, son of Manasseh, had no sons, but only daughters; and these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah[b], and Tirzah.

spob.text: Zelophehad was the son of Hepher, who was the son of Gilead, who was the son of Machir, who was the son of Manasseh. Zelophehad had no sons, only daughters. Their names were Mahlah, Noah[a], Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

public_domain_references.web: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
public_domain_references.asv: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: and these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

public_domain_references.brenton: And Salpaad the son of Opher had no sons but daughters: and these [are] the names of the daughters of Salpaad; Maala, and Nua, and Egla, and Melcha, and Thersa.

pob.text: So they came near before Eleazar the priest[a], and before Joshua son of Nun, and before the leaders, saying, “Yahweh commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers.” So he gave them, according to the command of Yahweh[c][b], an inheritance among their father's brothers.

spob.text: The daughters came to Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the leaders. They said, “Yahweh commanded Moses to give us inherited land among the men of our clan.” So he gave them inherited land among their father’s brothers—that is, within their father’s clan—as Yahweh had commanded.

public_domain_references.bsb: They approached Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the leaders, and said, “The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers.” So Joshua gave them an inheritance among their father’s brothers, in keeping with the command of the LORD.

pob.text: Ten portions fell to Manasseh[a], besides the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is beyond the Jordan.

public_domain_references.kjv: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh, beside the land of Gilead and Bashan, which [were] on the other side Jordan;

pob.text: For the daughters of Manasseh received an inheritance among his sons[c][b][a], and the land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the sons of Manasseh.

spob.text: For Manasseh’s daughters received a share of the land along with his sons. The land of Gilead went to the rest of Manasseh’s sons.

pob.text: And the border of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath[a], which is opposite Shechem; then the border went southward[c][b], toward the inhabitants of En-tappuah.

spob.text: Manasseh’s border ran from Asher to Michmethath,[a] opposite Shechem. Then it went southward toward the people living in En-tappuah.[b]

pob.text: Then the border went down to the Brook of Kanah[a], south of the brook. These cities belonged to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh, and the border of Manasseh was on the north side of the brook[c][b], and its end was at the sea.

spob.text: Then the border went down to the Brook of Kanah.[a] The cities south of the brook belonged to Ephraim and were within Manasseh’s territory. Manasseh’s border lay north of the brook and ended at the Mediterranean Sea.

pob.text: Southward it belonged to Ephraim[a], and northward to Manasseh, and the sea was its border; on the north they reached Asher, and on the east Issachar.

spob.text: The land to the south belonged to Ephraim, and the land to the north belonged to Manasseh. The sea was the western border. On the north, their territories bordered Asher, and on the east, they bordered Issachar.

public_domain_references.web: Southward it was Ephraim’s, and northward it was Manasseh’s, and the sea was his border. They reached to Asher on the north, and to Issachar on the east.
public_domain_references.asv: southward it was Ephraim’s, and northward it was Manasseh’s, and the sea was his border; and they reached to Asher on the north, and to Issachar on the east.

pob.text: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Beth-shean and its daughter villages[a], and Ibleam and its daughter villages, and the inhabitants of Dor and its daughter villages, and the inhabitants of En-dor and its daughter villages, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its daughter villages[b], and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its daughter villages—the three regions.

spob.text: Within the territories of Issachar and Asher, Manasseh’s allotment included Beth-shean and Ibleam, with their dependent villages.[a] It also included the inhabitants of Dor, En-dor, Taanach, and Megiddo, with the dependent villages of each town. These were the three regions.[b]

public_domain_references.asv: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-serah, which is in the hill-country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.
public_domain_references.kjv: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-serah, which [is] in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.
public_domain_references.brenton: And it came to pass after these things that Joshua the son of Naue the servant of the Lord died, [at the age] of a hundred and ten years.

pob.text: Israel served Yahweh all the days of Joshua[a], and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua and who had known all the work of Yahweh that he had done for Israel.

spob.text: Israel served Yahweh as long as Joshua lived. They continued to serve him as long as the elders who outlived Joshua were alive. These elders knew all that Yahweh had done for Israel.

public_domain_references.bsb: Israel had served the LORD throughout the days of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him and who had experienced all the works that the LORD had done for Israel.
public_domain_references.web: Israel served Yahweh all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, and had known all the work of Yahweh, that he had worked for Israel.
public_domain_references.asv: And Israel served Jehovah all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, and had known all the work of Jehovah, that he had wrought for Israel.
public_domain_references.kjv: And Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that overlived Joshua, and which had known all the works of the LORD, that he had done for Israel.
public_domain_references.brenton: And they buried him by the borders of his inheritance in Thamnasarach in the mount of Ephraim, northward of the mount of Galaad:

pob.text: And the bones of Joseph[a], which the sons of Israel had brought up from Egypt, they buried at Shechem, in the portion of the field that Jacob had bought from the sons of Hamor, the father of Shechem, for a hundred qesitahs[c][b]; and it became an inheritance for the sons of Joseph.

spob.text: The sons of Israel had brought Joseph’s bones up from Egypt. They buried them at Shechem, in the plot of land Jacob had bought from the sons of Hamor, the father of Shechem,[a] for one hundred qesitahs.[b] That land became an inheritance for Joseph’s sons.

public_domain_references.bsb: And the bones of Joseph, which the Israelites had brought up out of Egypt, were buried at Shechem in the plot of land that Jacob had purchased from the sons of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for a hundred pieces of silver. So it became an inheritance for Joseph’s descendants.
public_domain_references.web: They buried the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, in Shechem, in the parcel of ground which Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of silver. They became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.
public_domain_references.asv: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem, in the parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of money: and they became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem, in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver: and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the children of Israel brought up the bones of Joseph out of Egypt, and buried [them] in Sicima, in the portion of the land which Jacob bought of the Amorites who dwelt in Sicima for a hundred ewe-lambs; and he gave it to Joseph for a portion.

pob.text: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died, and they buried him at Gibeath-phinehas, his son’s hill country, which had been given to him in the hill country of Ephraim.

spob.text: Eleazar son of Aaron died. They buried him at Gibeath-phinehas, in the hill country of Ephraim, on land that had been given to his son Phinehas.

public_domain_references.bsb: Eleazar son of Aaron also died, and they buried him at Gibeah, which had been given to his son Phinehas in the hill country of Ephraim.
public_domain_references.web: Eleazar the son of Aaron died. They buried him in the hill of Phinehas his son, which was given him in the hill country of Ephraim.

public_domain_references.brenton: And it came to pass afterwards that Eleazar the high-priest the son of Aaron died, and was buried in Gabaar of Phinees his son, which he gave him in mount Ephraim.
